USAGE:
    fur database pgpass add [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help        Prints help information                                   
        --database    Database name (or * for wildcard)                         
        --host        Hostname or IP address of the PostgreSQL server           
        --port        TCP port of the PostgreSQL server                         
        --username    PostgreSQL username                                       
        --password    PostgreSQL password. Prompted interactively if not        
                      provided
notes: o Mustel acrescenta a forma posicional `pgpass add <banco>` (decisão do usuário)
